newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks bounce higher in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks bounce higher in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were higher in early Monday morning trade on a technical rebound after the Nikkei 225 sagged below the 20,000 level on Friday, brokers said.
They said strength in the U.S. markets late last week was fueling the rise.
As of 0015 GMT, the benchmark Nikkei was 103.71 points or 0.51 percent higher at 20,445.10. Its March futures were up 70 points at 20,380.
"Despite the rise, there are few incentives to prompt buying," a second-tier brokerage broker said. "It remains to be seen whether turnover will pick up or not."
